# Pesher Habakkuk Column 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** Upper portion heavily damaged; lower lines better preserved

---

**1:1** [...The or]acle that Habakkuk the prophet received [in a vision...]

**1:2** [...] How long, O LORD, shall I cry out and You will not hear? I cry out to You, "Violence!" and You will not save.

**1:3** Why do You show me iniquity and cause me to look upon wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife and contention arises [...]

**1:4** [Its interpretation concerns...] those who were unfaithful together with the Man of the Lie, for they did not [heed the words of] the Teacher of Righteousness from the mouth of God.

**1:5** And also [it concerns] those who were unfaithful to the new [covenant,] for they did not believe in the covenant of God [and profaned] His holy name.

**1:6** And likewise this saying is to be interpreted concerning the unfaith[ful] at the end of days.

**1:7** They are the ruthless ones of the covenant who will not believe

**1:8** when they hear all that is to come upon the final generation

**1:9** from the mouth of the priest into whose heart

**1:10** God placed understanding to interpret all the words of His servants the prophets,

**1:11** [through] whom God declared all that is to come upon His people and [His] congregation.

**1:12** "For the Torah grows feeble, and justice never goes forth;

**1:13** for the wicked surrounds the righteous" (Hab 1:4).

**1:14** [Its interpretation:] the wicked one is the Wicked Priest, and the righteous one

**1:15** is the Teacher of Righteousness [...]

**1:16** "Look among the nations and observe,

**1:17** and be astonished, be utterly astounded [...]" (Hab 1:5)

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 1 covers Hab 1:1-5. This translation maintains formal equivalence while rendering readable English. The pesher (interpretation) sections apply Habakkuk's prophecy to the Qumran community's historical situation. Key figures: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, the Kittim (Romans). "Interpretation" used consistently for pesher. Lacunae [...] indicate physical manuscript damage.*
